title: File:西长安街.jpg
claims: The image is an elevated daylight view of West Chang'an Avenue: a broad multi-lane boulevard with a central divider, tree-lined sidewalks, office buildings and distant high-rises.

Commons describes the photograph as 西长安街 俯视, a downward view of West Chang'an Avenue; it shows ordinary traffic and street furniture, not a closed race course, start arch, timing mat, aid station or finish line.
The author is 維基小霸王; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2021-04-07 at 09:24:40; the original is 5,007 x 3,338 pixels and 5,402,511 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 189,335 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits 維基小霸王, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
